title: 第1章 异世唐风
content_zh:
自从十五年前唐风一身武艺稍有小成，出了唐家堡游历四方，在车水马龙的大马路上舍命救下一位即将被撞的孩子之后，他就一直很倒霉。

那次被撞让他这十五年来一直躺在床上，彻底成为了一个废人。虽然门中几位长老多番为他输入精纯内力，却始终无法让他重新站立起来。

这件事让整个唐门的高层都蹉叹不已，唐风是唐门百年来不世出的奇才，假以时日，唐风的成就必然能超过所有人，但是这份希望却早早夭折了。

躺在床上这些年，唐风也自问过无数次，如果时间能够倒流，在他知道结果的情况下自己是否还会去救下那个即将被撞的孩子。

答案是会！如果不救，唐风自问这一辈子自己也无法安心，日后成就再高又能如何？虽然最终落得个下半身残疾的下场，可却换来一生的心安。

十五年来，唐风查阅了天下所有的医经，结合自己的现状，研究出了一套金针刺穴的医疗手法，这才刚有起色，好不容易感觉自己的下半身有了一些反应，一道闪电横空出世劈中了唐风，迷迷糊糊地就被牛头马面两位鬼神锁到了阎罗殿。

唐风想破脑袋也想不明白，自己明明在床上躺着，没惹谁没招谁，怎么就有一道闪电从窗户劈了进来，而且还那么精妙准确地劈中了自己。

抬头看了看高台上端坐如山的黑面壮汉，唐风强忍着心头的怒火，冷目相视。

就是他，号称掌管活人生死，调控阴魂轮回的阎罗王。

“唐风！”阎王将桌子惊堂木一拍，大喝一声。

“你可知罪？”阎王摇头晃脑，又喝一声。

“我何罪之有？”唐风面红耳赤地怒吼。

“你可知道你这一世多活了十五年？早在十五年前你就应该魂归地府，进那轮回之道。”阎王干咳一声，口气虽然强硬，可底气却稍显不足。

“阎王要你三更死，谁敢留你到五更？”唐风瞪着台上阎罗说道，“生死不由我，是在你的掌控之下！我又怎会多活十五年？”

“咳，这……”阎王脸色讪讪，“本王事物繁忙，有时候是难免有些失误。”

“这关我屁事？”唐风越想越是生气，“十五年前我舍命救下一人，换来的却是十五年卧榻之苦，如今好不容易有了些起色，你又让牛头马面捉我到此！我何罪之有，你又算哪门子阎王？”

眼看唐风就要暴走，牛头马面在一旁赶紧拉住他，口上陪笑道：“息怒息怒！”

阎王的黑脸越发见黑，弱弱道：“不管如何，你多活了十五年却是个事实。”

“待我算算看……”阎王装模作样掐指一算，口上惊讶叫道：“哎呀，恭喜你，你下一世还是轮回为人，这就好办多了。”

“你这一世多活了十五年，那么就从下一世斩去十五年寿元作为赔偿，算得上公平吧？”阎王搓着手笑呵呵地问道，俨然就是市井中的小贩。

“凭什么？”唐风大怒，“这是你的错，为什么要我来承担？”

“鉴于你十五年前救下一人，成就无上功德，本王免去你重新成为婴儿之苦。牛头马面，带他进轮回通道，找个十五岁年纪的庐舍，让他托魂转世去吧。”阎王大手一摆，竟然不再理会唐风的怒骂。

牛头马面好不容易把唐风拉扯出阎罗殿，引着他朝轮回道走去。

“小兄弟，塞翁失马焉知非福？”牛头在一旁劝解道。

“是啊是啊。”马面也在一旁猛点头。

唐风猛翻白眼：“这算什么福运？平白无故就被斩去了十五年寿元，换做是你，你愿意？”

“话不能这么说。”牛头压低了声音，凑近唐风耳畔边道：“阎王对你算是很不错了，虽然这件事错不在你，但你多活了十五年却是无可争议的。难道你没发现阎王都没让你喝孟婆汤，走奈何桥么，这也算是一种补偿。”

马面也在一旁道：“这次再入轮回，你是托魂转世，所以那具身体并不是按你本身的意愿成长起来的。阎王怕你不喜欢，特意嘱咐我兄弟二人再送你一份大礼。”

“什么大礼？”唐风疑惑道。经历最初的暴怒，唐风也渐渐平静了下来，自己这一生，有十五年躺在床上，虽然说现在有点起色，可谁知道最后自己是否真的能再站起来？

与其继续躺在床上饱受折磨，吃喝拉撒都要人伺候，还不如早点解脱，所谓早死早超生。

牛头马面对视一笑，马面伸出手指，在唐风额头上一点，一大串莫名其妙的信息就进入了唐风脑海中，唐风还没来得及消化，只见牛头大手一张，一股阴风暴起，夹杂着无数呜咽哀号之声，一点绿光幽幽地出现在他的掌心上。

牛头道：“这是我十年鬼神修为，再多的话你承受不了，对你转世之后的身体有帮助。”一边说着，牛头曲指一弹，这团幽幽的绿光便进入了唐风体内。

想了想，唐风又好奇地问道：“阎王经常这样忘记收人魂魄么？”

马面砸砸嘴道：“也不是经常，偶尔有那么一次。”

唐风呵呵笑道：“看样子我并不孤单。”

牛头感慨万千：“小兄弟你算是幸运的了。我记得有个人那才叫悲惨。多活了整整八百年之后阎王才想起收他魂魄，本来他这几十世中还有几次可以轮回为人，可就因为这样，直到现在还走的畜生道，一直在还债。”

“恩！”马面唏嘘不已：“我记得那人叫彭祖！”

一生中经历的事情就仿佛走花灯似的在唐风面前闪现，从出生到死亡，事无巨细，让唐风有一种如梦似幻的不真实感觉，也不知道过了多久，进入轮回道的魂魄终于变得沉重起来，慢慢地下坠，最终落到了谷底。

耳鸣，目眩，头脑发昏，虽然让人很难受，但是唐风知道，这是自己的魂魄在跟这具身体开始融合的征兆。

牛头马面最后告诉过他，因为轮回道连接了无数位面，所以他们也无法得知唐风会进入什么地方，甚至连这次重生之后唐风是男是女也无法判断。

千万不要是个女人！唐风心中暗暗祈祷起来，若是让自己一个大男人的魂魄进入一个女人的身体，还不如直接死了算了。

渐渐地，那种强烈的不适稍微淡薄了一点，虽然如此，可魂魄仿佛被撕扯的那种疼痛却依然让人无法忍受。无数原本属于这个身体的记忆蜂拥而来，一瞬间充斥了唐风的所有思维。

唐风第一时间将最重要的信息抽离了出来，不由自主地松了口气。

是个男人！自己正在融合的这具身体是个男人，而且巧合的是，这具身体原本的姓名也叫唐风。

看来真是有缘啊，唐风不禁感慨万千。

任由魂魄和身体慢慢融合，唐风开始整理自己脑海中多出来的无数信息。

这个世界已经不是自己原本的世界了，也没有唐家堡，更没有先进的科技技术，这个世界繁衍出了属于自己的文明。

这是一片被称为天罡大陆的地方，和原来的世界不同，天罡大陆习武成风，各种大小宗门、世家和势力林立其中，占据着或大或小一块范围繁衍生存，甚至就算是普通人，也有习武的习惯和根基，只不过天资不同，所学不同，终究限制了他们的发展，虽说如此，可天罡大陆中人的平均寿命却比原来的世界高出不少。一个普通人活上百来岁还老当益壮也是正常的事情。若是稍有成就，能活个几百岁也不在话下。

唐风现在身处的地方便是天罡大陆李唐帝国其中一家宗门的所在，天秀宗。

天秀宗和其他宗门不同，宗内从宗主到长老再到普通弟子，全是女人！没有任何男人的存在。唐风也是因为一些特殊的原因才留在宗内，而且不日便要离开这里。

整个宗门内全是女子的在天罡大陆也不是没有，比如说翠微坊和抱花堂，她们的选人标准和天秀宗一样，只要女子，不要男人。但若是论名气，还是天秀宗更大一些，甚至可以说犹有过之。

原因无他，在多年之前，天秀宗也是很有名气的宗门，整个宗门下辖弟子上万，高手无数。但自从十几年前经历被称为“天秀惨变”的磨难之后，宗门实力大减，再被敌对势力趁机骚扰围攻几次，宗门弟子损伤无数，这才渐渐衰落了下来。今日的天秀宗，已不复往昔的光辉。

正当唐风在融合着这些记忆的时候，鼻尖却突然传来一抹幽幽体香，感觉象是有个女人凑近自己，因为有几缕发梢扫过了唐风的脸颊，痒痒的。

耳畔边随之传来一阵紧张无比甚至颤抖的声音：“唐风，不要怪我，我也不想这样，可是柳公子说……只要杀了你，他就会娶我！我要为肚子里的孩子考虑！而且，你我本来就不般配，你这种人怎么能对我有想法？对不起！”

听到这番话，唐风大急。心想老子才刚刚托魂转世重生，怎地莫名其妙就有人要来杀自己了？他想动，可是却根本无能为力，浑身上下一点力气也使不出来。

“蹭”地一声轻响，那是利刃出鞘的声音，唐风甚至可以想象到，一个女人就站在自己床边，手上拎着一柄长剑，慢慢地将剑尖朝自己捅来。

一抹冰凉带着死亡气息的感觉从胸口处传了过来，胸口处传来一丝疼痛。如果自己再不反抗的话，下一刻就会再次回到阎罗殿。

不知道到那时候牛头马面看到自己会做何感想。

天罡大陆一日游？还附赠返程票的！

危机关头，唐风原本浑浑噩噩的脑海突然一阵清明，也不知道哪生出的力气，猛地睁开了眼睛，怒喝一声：“贱人！”

床边站着的女子原本就心惊胆颤，这是她生平第一次杀人，手法难免不够娴熟，再加上心虚无比，被唐风这么一吼，不由惶恐无比地抬头朝唐风看去，四目相对之下，这个女子的瞳孔一瞬间瞪得老大。

无边血海，滚滚骷髅，积尸成山，流血漂橹！更有无数狰狞的鬼怪张牙舞爪地朝她扑来。

“啊！”一声撕心裂肺般的惨叫从这名女子的口中迸发了出来。

唐风抬脚朝她手腕处踢去，长剑斜飞，叮当落在地上，但是面前那名女子却傻傻地看着自己，目光呆滞无比。

鲜血不受控制地从伤口处流淌了出来，唐风伸手在胸口处连点几下，急速涌出的血液总算变缓了下来。

新书开张，求收藏，求点击，求包养！
content_en:
Tang Feng has been very unlucky ever since he gained some martial arts skills fifteen years ago, traveled around Tangjiapu, and risked his life to save a child who was about to be hit on a busy road.

That hit made him lie in bed for the past fifteen years, completely turning him into a cripple.Although several elders in the sect repeatedly injected pure internal energy into him, they were still unable to get him to stand up again.

This incident made the entire Tang Sect's senior management sigh. Tang Feng was a genius that the Tang Sect had never produced in a hundred years. Given time, Tang Feng's achievements would surely surpass everyone else's, but this hope died early.

During these years of lying in bed, Tang Feng had asked himself countless times, if he could turn back time, would he still save the child who was about to be hit if he knew the outcome.

The answer is yes!If he didn't save him, Tang Feng asked himself that he wouldn't be able to feel at ease in this life. What would happen no matter how high his achievements would be in the future?Although he ended up with a disability in his lower body, he gained a lifetime of peace of mind.

In the past fifteen years, Tang Feng has consulted all the medical scriptures in the world, and combined with his current situation, he has developed a set of medical techniques of gold acupuncture points. It has just started to improve, and he finally feels some reaction in his lower body. A bolt of lightning appears from the sky and hits Tang Feng. In a daze, he is locked into the Yama Palace by the two ghosts and gods with a bull head and a horse face.

Tang Feng thought hard and couldn't figure it out. He was lying on the bed without provoking anyone, so why did a bolt of lightning come through the window and hit him so exquisitely and accurately.

Looking up at the strong black-faced man sitting upright on the high platform, Tang Feng suppressed the anger in his heart and looked at each other coldly.

This is him, the King of Yama who claims to be in charge of life and death and regulates the reincarnation of ghosts.

"Tang Feng!" The King of Hell slapped the table and shouted loudly.

"Do you know your sin?" The King of Hell shook his head and shouted again.

"What crime am I guilty of?" Tang Feng roared with a red face.

"Did you know that you lived an extra fifteen years in this life? Fifteen years ago, you should have returned to the underworld and entered the path of reincarnation." The King of Hell coughed dryly. Although his tone was tough, his confidence was slightly lacking.

"The King of Hell wants you to die at the third watch, who dares to keep you until the fifth watch?" Tang Feng glared at Yama on the stage and said, "Life or death is not up to me, it is under your control! How can I live for fifteen more years?"

"Ahem, this..." The King of Hell said with a stern look on his face, "I am very busy with things, so sometimes it is inevitable that I will make some mistakes."

"Is this none of my business?" The more Tang Feng thought about it, the angrier he became, "Fifteen years ago, I sacrificed my life to save a person, but what I got in exchange was the pain of being bedridden for fifteen years. Now that I have finally made some progress, you let a bull-headed horse catch me here again! What crime am I guilty of, and who are you, the king of hell?"

Seeing that Tang Feng was about to run away, the bull-headed horse-faced man quickly grabbed him and said with a smile: "Calm down your anger!"

The dark face of the King of Hell became darker and darker, and he said weakly: "No matter what, it is a fact that you have lived for fifteen more years."

"Let me do the math..." The King of Hell pretended to count, and shouted in surprise: "Oh, congratulations, you will be reincarnated as a human being in the next life, which will be much easier to handle."

"You have lived an extra fifteen years in this life, so it is fair to take away fifteen years of your life from the next life as compensation, right?" The King of Hell asked with a smile while rubbing his hands, just like a hawker in the market.

"Why?" Tang Feng was furious, "This is your fault, why should I bear it?"

"In view of the fact that you saved a person fifteen years ago and achieved supreme merit, I will spare you the pain of becoming a baby again. Take him into the reincarnation passage with a bull-headed horse-face, find a house where he is fifteen years old, and let him reincarnate as a soul." The King of Hell waved his hand and ignored Tang Feng's scolding.

The bull-headed horse-faced man finally pulled Tang Feng out of the Yama Palace and led him towards the path of reincarnation.

"Little brother, a blessing in disguise is a blessing in disguise?" Niu Tou persuaded from the side.

"Yes, yes." Ma Mian also nodded fiercely.

Tang Feng rolled his eyes fiercely: "What kind of luck is this? Fifteen years of life were cut off for no reason. Would you like it if it were you?"

"You can't say that." Niu Tou lowered his voice and leaned into Tang Feng's ear and said, "The King of Hell has been very kind to you. Although this matter is not your fault, it is indisputable that you have lived for fifteen more years. Haven't you noticed that the King of Hell didn't even let you drink Meng Po soup or walk on the Naihe Bridge? This can be considered a kind of compensation."

Ma Mian also said at the side: "This time you are reincarnated as a soul, so the body did not grow according to your own wishes. The King of Hell was afraid that you would not like it, so he specially asked my two brothers to give you another big gift."

"What kind of gift?" Tang Feng asked doubtfully.After experiencing the initial rage, Tang Feng gradually calmed down. He had been lying in bed for fifteen years in his life. Although he was getting better now, who knew whether he would really be able to stand up again in the end?

Rather than continue to lie in bed and suffer torture, having to eat, drink, and have sex with others, it is better to get rid of it as soon as possible. The so-called early death and early rebirth.

The bull-headed horse looked at each other and smiled. The horse-faced finger stretched out and touched Tang Feng's forehead. A bunch of inexplicable information entered Tang Feng's mind. Before Tang Feng had time to digest it, he saw the bull-headed big hand open up. A dark storm rose, mixed with countless whimpering and wailing sounds, and a green light faintly appeared on his palm.

Niutou said: "This is my ten years of ghost and god cultivation. If you can't bear it any more, it will help your body after reincarnation." As he said that, Niutou curled his fingers, and this faint green light entered Tang Feng's body.

After thinking about it, Tang Feng asked curiously: "Does the King of Hell often forget to collect people's souls like this?"

The horse slapped his face and said: "It's not often, it happens once in a while."

Tang Feng chuckled and said, "It looks like I'm not alone."

Niutou was full of emotions: "Little brother, you are lucky. I remember there was a person who was called miserable. After living for eight hundred years, the King of Hell thought of collecting his soul. Originally, he could be reincarnated as a human several times in his dozens of lives, but because of this, he still follows the path of an animal until now, and has been paying off his debts."

"Yes!" Ma Mian exclaimed: "I remember that person's name is Peng Zu!"

Everything he had experienced in his life flashed in front of Tang Feng like a lantern, from birth to death, everything was microscopic, giving Tang Feng an unreal feeling like a dream. He didn't know how long it took, but the soul that entered the reincarnation finally became heavy, slowly fell, and finally fell to the bottom.

Although the tinnitus, dizziness, and dizziness were uncomfortable, Tang Feng knew that this was a sign that his soul was beginning to merge with this body.

Minotaur Horse Face finally told him that because the path of reincarnation connected countless planes, they could not know where Tang Feng would enter, and they could not even tell whether Tang Feng was a boy or girl after this rebirth.

Never be a woman!Tang Feng secretly prayed in his heart. If he let the soul of a grown man enter the body of a woman, he might as well just die.

Gradually, the intense discomfort became slightly less intense. Even so, the pain that felt like my soul was being torn apart was still unbearable.Countless memories that originally belonged to this body swarmed in, filling all of Tang Feng's thoughts in an instant.

Tang Feng extracted the most important information immediately and breathed a sigh of relief involuntarily.

It's a man!The body he is merging with is that of a man, and coincidentally, the original name of this body is also Tang Feng.

It seemed like they were really destined. Tang Feng couldn't help but be filled with emotion.

Allowing his soul and body to slowly merge, Tang Feng began to sort out the countless extra information in his mind.

This world is no longer our original world. There is no Tangjiabao, and there is no advanced technology. This world has developed its own civilization.

This is a place called Tiangang Continent. Unlike the original world, martial arts practice is common in Tiangang Continent. Various large and small sects, aristocratic families and forces are present in it, occupying a large or small area to thrive and survive. Even ordinary people have the habit and foundation of martial arts. However, their talents and learning are different, which ultimately limits their development. Even so, the average life span of people in Tiangang Continent is much higher than that of the original world.It is normal for an ordinary person to live for hundreds of years and still stay strong and healthy.If you achieve a little bit, you can live for hundreds of years.

The place where Tang Feng is now is the location of one of the sects of the Li Tang Empire in Tiangang Continent, the Tianxiu Sect.

Tianxiu Sect is different from other sects. From the sect leader to the elders to ordinary disciples, all of them are women!There is no presence of any man.Tang Feng also stayed in the sect for some special reasons, and he would leave here soon.

It is not uncommon in Tiangang Continent to have entire sects that are all women, such as Cuiweifang and Baohuatang. Their selection criteria are the same as those of Tianxiu Sect. They only want women, not men.But in terms of reputation, Tianxiu Sect is still greater, and it can even be said that it is even better.

There is no other reason. Many years ago, Tianxiu Sect was also a very famous sect. The entire sect had tens of thousands of disciples and countless masters.However, since the sect experienced the ordeal known as the "Tianxiu Tragedy" more than ten years ago, the sect's strength has been greatly reduced. It was harassed and besieged several times by hostile forces, causing numerous injuries to the sect's disciples, and then it gradually declined.Today's Tianxiu Sect has lost its former glory.

Just as Tang Feng was integrating these memories, a faint body fragrance suddenly came from the tip of his nose. It felt like a woman was approaching him, because a few strands of hair brushed Tang Feng's cheek, tickling him.

A nervous and even trembling voice came next to his ears: "Tang Feng, don't blame me, I don't want to do this, but Mr. Liu said... as long as I kill you, he will marry me! I have to think about the child in my belly! Besides, you and I are not a good match, how can someone like you have thoughts about me? I'm sorry!"

Tang Feng was very anxious after hearing these words.I thought to myself that I had just been reincarnated as a soul, why would someone come to kill me out of nowhere?He wanted to move, but he couldn't do anything. He couldn't exert any strength in his body.

There was a soft "squeak" sound, which was the sound of a sharp blade being unsheathed. Tang Feng could even imagine a woman standing beside his bed, holding a long sword in her hand, and slowly stabbing the tip of the sword towards him.

A cold feeling with the aura of death came from his chest, and there was a hint of pain in his chest.If he doesn't resist, he will return to the Yama Hall again in the next moment.

I don’t know what Minotaur Horsemian will think when he sees me.

One-day trip to Tiangang Continent?It also comes with a return ticket!
